values.note: 164 campsites, 95 reservable: 81 electric (27 of them double sites with two hookups) and 14 non-electric; the other 69 non-electric sites are first-come. ReserveAmerica single sites take 40-84 ft (electric back-ins to 65 ft; non-electric pull-throughs to 80 ft and a drive-through 84 ft); the double sites run to 146 ft.

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/tongue-river-reservoir ('The park offers a total of 164 campsites with 95 of those campsites being reservable. There are 81 reservable sites with electric hookups, with 27 of those with electric being double occupancy campsites ... There are 83 non-electric campsites with 14 being reservable and 69 first-come, first serve') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630715 (Max Vehicle Length per site; 27 Pull-Through, 16 Drive-Through), read 2026-10-12/2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/tongue-river-reservoir ('Each electric site has 50 amp, 30 amp, and 120 volt outlets') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630715 (every campsite 'Full Hookup - no'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Dump station and water faucets during peak season, weather permitting; 23 vault toilets; fish cleaning station. The marina store at Campers Point sells firewood, ice, groceries, bait, gasoline and boat rentals.

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/tongue-river-reservoir ('A dump station and water faucets are available during peak season, as weather permits. The park also has a fish cleaning station and 23 vault toilets', 'A marina store at Campers Point offers firewood, ice, fishing and boating supplies, boat rentals ... groceries, snacks, drinks, gasoline'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations only for peak season (third Friday of May to third Sunday of September), up to 3 months ahead and at least 1 day before arrival; 69 non-electric sites are always first-come, and every site is first-come off season.

booking.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/tongue-river-reservoir ('Reservations for camping are available peak season which is defined as the third Friday of May until and the third Sunday of September. Reservations can be made 3 months in advance. During off season, all sites are "first come, first serve"') + https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/tongue-river-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630715 ('Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-22

note: MT state park on the 12-mile Tongue River Reservoir near Decker, among red-shale and juniper canyons. Six campgrounds (Campers Point, Pee Wee North/South, Riverside, Rattlesnake Point, Sand Point); electric only at Campers Point and Pee Wee South. Two boat ramps with docks (Campers Point by the marina, Pee Wee North); Sand Point has a small swimming beach. --Claude
summary: FWP page + ReserveAmerica: confirmed reservable on RA with some FCFS, 3-month window and 1-day cutoff (now verified for this park), vault toilets and dump. Changed sites 156 -> 164; added 50-amp electric (no sewer), 84-ft max single site with pull-throughs, potable water (peak season), marina store. Fees (FWP schedule; page only says $4-$34) and season (manual, year-round) left. Not stated: 7-night limit (inherited). Note: old site counts dropped, restatements trimmed.
